plaintext_text: Tree figure, no Arabic words. Description: 5 rows (r1 y~920-1060, ... r5 y~1300-1420) of stylised 'trees': each row has 2-4 long black ground-lines (baselines) with upturned ends, like trays; on each baseline stand 3-9 small tree/branch glyphs ('feathers': a vertical stem with 1-5 pairs of slanting side branches, a few with a Y or forked tip, a few tall ones); the number of side-twigs and height vary. Above the top of each tree stands one small red Arabic letter (about 13 red letters in row1, 14 row2, 14 row3, 13 row4, 13 row5, i.e. one per tree, so ~67 trees). Red letters read right to left, rough reading with [?]: row1: ا ى [?] ن ك ب ى و د ا ل ص ى غ ر ; row2: ك ف و ل ل ن [?] ط ع ن ش ى ب ه ك ن [?] ; row3: ع ن ي ك ث ن ى د ا ن ا ت و/ح ن ا ل ا [?] ; row4: ى ي ح د ج ق ا ل ل ى ع ن د ف? ; row5: ى و ن ر ن ك ه ت ق ك ل ى د ا. Red letters do not form obvious Arabic words when read as printed; they are likely the values of the trees (the tree-sign alphabet gloss), or the plaintext letters in order. Not read further. Vertical marginal text to the right of the figure (x~950-1150, written along the side, 3 lines): '[?]والبيت ها / ابري كبير والصغير يقول لي اطعن حسابه وكن ص[?] / نا ديت هذا الاجوز فقال لي عندي بحور [?] ' - uncertain, appears to describe the sizes (big/small) of trees: 'the big and the small' ... 'he says to me thrust (the trees)'.

reason_if_unanswered: No 'fa-halaltuhu ... wa-huwa' and no solved text follows on 73v or at the top of 74r. The block is the 5-line cipher (l.9-13 by my count; l.8 is the intro 'فكتبت للمشار اليه عظم الله شانه' = I wrote to the aforementioned, may God magnify his dignity) in a story about a chancery signatory (al-mawqi'): l.1-7 (compiler's narration) say that when the kings decree writing the tawqi' ('ولما رسم الملوك بكتابة توقيعه الشريف ... فكتب المجلس السامي وما بعدها بغير با ولم يذكر الحمدلله ولا السياقة وهي حل المقصود ... فلا بد من مرسوم المخدوم العالي اسبغ الله ظلاله'): it concerns whether the hamdala, the 'ba' and the siyaqa (accounts-script) are written; the cipher is the message he wrote to the makhdum. 73v l.13 'ثم نظمت بيتين اخرين في طريق القلعة وترجمتهما في طبقة' continues on 74r l.1-2 ('القاضي ناصر الدين بن الشاعر [?] موقع الدست الشريف على عجلة وارسلتهما اليه') and then a second 5-line cipher (74r l.3-7). 74r l.8-13 is commentary (the mawqi' asks, tawqi' is changed, siyaqa/iqtab, 'fa-fa'al thumma arsala al-mutarjimayn'), no verse. At the top of 74v l.1-3 a verse is given: l.1 '...البيت وقد كتب الثاني وهو' ; l.2 'اباخر الجود بلا منقض [?] ويا بدرا تمضي بلا محاق' ; l.3 'تصدق بالسياقة ان نفسي تناهت في السياق ...' (= 'give alms of the siyaqa, my soul has reached the death-throes'); this may answer the second (74r l.3-7) cipher, and the first verse (answer to the 73v cipher) is not clearly marked: not found.
